articles.title: "India's First Cathode Material Unit": 12 Electronics Projects Get ₹7,503 Crore Push
articles.description: India is stepping up efforts to build a strong domestic electronics manufacturing ecosystem. Electronics and IT Secretary S. Krishnan announced approvals for 12 new projects under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS), involving investments worth ₹7,503 crore. The projects are expected to generate production worth over ₹39,000 crore and create more than 7,000 jobs. A major highlight is India's first commercial cathode material manufacturing unit, which could help reduce dependence on imports. With projects spread across seven states, the government is also strengthening upstream manufacturing, including critical materials and capital equipment, to boost India's electronics industry.

articles.title: Tata Motors Apps Face Cybersecurity Scare As Company Rolls Out New Security Update For Car Owners
articles.description: Tata Motors' connected car apps, IRA 2.0 and IRA.EV, have come under a cybersecurity scare after CERT-In flagged four high-severity vulnerabilities. The flaws could potentially allow hackers to steal authentication credentials, impersonate vehicle owners and access sensitive vehicle-related information and services. Karan Dhar, Business Today, brings you the details of the security risks and the company's response. Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles says the vulnerabilities have been addressed through software updates and enhanced security measures. The company maintains that there is no evidence of customer data or vehicle information being compromised and urges users to install the latest app updates.

articles.title: Drones carrying drones: Turkey turns Bayraktar TB2 into flying weapons carrier

This integration not only enhances the operational range of these attack drones but also allows the TB2 to act as a communications hub, potentially redefining strategic warfare through coordinated aerial strikes from a single unit.
